summary: Routine is configured to audit https://positive-animal-wellbeing.netlify.app, but the site's own canonical tag, robots.txt Sitemap directive, sitemap.xml and llms.txt all declare https://pawellbeing.com as the real domain. Firecrawl's resolved metadata.url for every fetch also came back as pawellbeing.com. This routine continued auditing the configured Netlify URL so the diff stays comparable, per the CONFIG-finding rule.
